text: It's a good place, a large and spacious university. I took my nephew to football tryouts today, and it was incredibly hot – so hot I felt like I was melting! I also couldn't find any restaurants; there was only one coffee shop next to the field, near the green bridge. I didn't see any other shops. I guess it was because it was Saturday.
